items.quote: Elhanan son of Jair the Bethlehemite killed the brother of Goliath the Gittite, who had a spear with a shaft like a weaver’s rod.
items.contrast: Saph was killed in one battle at Gob, whereas Goliath’s brother was killed in the Gob battle associated with the spear-shaft comparison.
items.reason: The reader must distinguish between two battles at the same location and connect the spear description to the second battle. The wording and key resolve that contrast directly.
